description.zh:
过滤器名称，可选择一个或者多个名称进行查询。取值范围：

- StartTime: 按日志事件的开始时间查询。
- EndTime: 按ActionTrail事件的结束时间查询。
- EventName: 按ActionTrail事件的名称查询。
- ResourceName: 按ActionTrail资源名称查询。
- ApplicationGroupName: 按应用程序组名称查询。
description.en:
The filter name. You can query by one or more filter names. Valid values:

- StartTime: Queries logs by the start time of the log event.

- EndTime: Queries logs by the end time of the ActionTrail event.

- EventName: Queries logs by the name of the ActionTrail event.

- ResourceName: Queries logs by the ActionTrail resource name.

- ApplicationGroupName: Queries logs by the application group name.

description.zh: 过滤器值列表。N的取值范围：1~10。
description.en: A list of filter values. The value of N can be from 1 to 10.

description.zh:
选择日志源。可选值：

- computeNest（默认值）：服务实例部署、升级的日志。

- application：应用产生的日志。

- actionTrail: 操作审计日志

- ros: ROS日志

- compliancePack: 合规包日志
description.en:
The log source. Valid values:

- computeNest (default): The deployment and upgrade logs of the service instance.

- application: The logs generated by the application.

- actionTrail: The ActionTrail audit logs.

- ros: The ROS logs.

- compliancePack: The compliance package logs.

description.zh:
Logstore信息。
查询应用日志时，需要指定Logstore。
description.en: The Logstore. This parameter is required when you query application logs.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页行数。其中最大值为100行，默认值为20行。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。
description.en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Set this to the NextToken value that was returned in the last response.

description.zh:
排序方向。取值范围：
+ Ascending：升序
+ Descending（默认值）：降序
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- Ascending: Ascending order.

- Descending (default): Descending order.

title.zh: 查询服务实例的部署和升级日志
